newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: No deal with Taiwan's Chunghwa - SingTel.
newsitem.headline: No deal with Taiwan's Chunghwa - SingTel.

text.p: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (SingTel) said on Monday it had not agreed to launch a satellite communications joint venture with Taiwan's Chunghwa Telecommunication Corp, as reported by a Taiwanese newspaper.
The Commercial Times said on Monday that Chunghwa had agreed to buy a five percent stake in SingTel's ICO satellite company and the deal would be struck "in the short-term".
But a SingTel spokesman said the newspaper report was wrong.
"That's incorrect," said SingTel spokesman Ricardo Villanueva. "A number of parties have shown interest in participating in ICO, but at this time nothing is finalised."
He said the newspaper might have been confused with another SingTel satellite communications venture with Chunghwa, ST1, which was announced in mid-1996.
